set.body:
Run a bounded JavaFX-native feasibility spike before committing the JVM architecture. Compile SurfaceRenderPlan geometry into TriangleMesh with POINT_NORMAL_TEXCOORD, validated counter-clockwise faces, normals, PerspectiveCamera, and a depth-buffered antialiased SubScene. Bake final per-vertex composited RGBA into per-face texture-atlas tiles with padding/edge dilation, chunking by safe texture size, direct IntBuffer PixelBuffer storage, and dirty-region updates. Exercise diffuse-lit and self-illuminated/unlit materials.

Benchmark 32k and 164k vertex meshes with 1, 4, and 8 logical layers. Record mesh construction, atlas construction, threshold/colormap update, full data replacement, JavaFX pulse/render, snapshot, memory, and pick latency. Hard correctness gates compare landmark projections, face winding, vertex colors, thresholds, and screenshots against the reference renderer. Hard structural gates require no geometry rebuild for style/data updates and no mesh or atlas update for camera motion. On a documented pinned machine, target camera p95 <= 16.7 ms at 32k and <= 33.3 ms at 164k; record rather than conceal misses. A no-go decision must identify the failed gate and create a narrowly scoped LWJGL fallback issue without changing shared APIs.
set.title: JavaFX feasibility gate: native TriangleMesh plus dynamic per-face texture atlas
